items.comment: Human-approved waiver: parenthetical synonym in the source phrase "zero or below zero (negative)"; the negative polarity is already formalized by calculated_level(c) <= 0.
Human-approved waiver: "respective" is absorbed by reusing the same index variable i in calculated_index(c, i) and terminates_index(t, i).
Human-approved waiver: "such termination" is absorbed by announces_termination(a, t), where t is the termination event introduced in the same consequent.
Human-approved waiver: "available at" is represented by document_part_url(NewsSection, HttpsWwwSolactiveComNewsAnnouncements) plus the website/section chain, not by a separate availability predicate.
Human-approved waiver: "For clarification" is a discourse marker introducing the permission sentence; it does not add a separate domain predicate beyond the permission itself.
